protocol.measurementClock: deterministic clock advancing 1 ms per read (production condition, reproducible)
protocol.equivalenceClock: frozen at 2026-11-03T00:00:00.000Z with a deterministic UUID sequence; durable output must be byte-identical
protocol.order: each round alternates which side runs first
protocol.sides: baseline restores lib/domain-storage.js from the recorded revision into a copy of lib/; candidate is this working tree
protocol.warmup: the seeded history is absorbed by a cold pass, then `warmup` flushed bursts
protocol.instrumentedPass: one additional pass per side per scenario (in the first round) with wrapped fs/crypto/structuredClone calls and a GC observer; the counters are opened after the new records are signed and appended, so every count is exactly one flush, and GC entries are attributed by their own start time
protocol.historyShape: the seeded history is a committed applied marker table plus its signed log. The `-hot` scenarios also seed an aggregate that stays inside the memory's per-collection hot window for the whole run (so every pass writes the document once), the `-evict` scenarios seed the `experiments` window at its limit (so every applied record evicts one and every pass also stages an archive file), and the `-archive` scenarios additionally seed a non-empty dockyard archive tree.
protocol.expectedDocumentWrites: 0 per steady pass (no new record), 1 per advancing flush, 2 for the `-evict` ones, which also stage an archive file; the injected run asserts the exact count per shape
